annotations.title: Cheapest perp DEX for a trade

description: Quick answer: the single cheapest decentralised perpetual exchange right now to open and close one market order of your size, taker fees on both legs plus slippage walked on the live order book, across 28 perp DEXs (Hyperliquid, Lighter, Aster, Extended, Paradex…). Returns the winner, its cost in USD and the runner-up, every figure with its time and source. Use it when you only need where to trade; use trading_cost for every venue ranked, or execution_plan to split a large order across several.
